name: Cross-sectional funding dispersion — daily-rebalance most-negative-funding tilt (long, 1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: the same sticky-funding dispersion long tilt as variant 16, but rebalanced on a DAILY clock with a slower multi-day hold — targeting the persistent (not intraday) funding-dispersion premium in mid-cap/long-tail perps. Each day, names whose funding_rate is deeply negative in the cross-section (crowded shorts, squeeze fuel) are bought SPOT (direction +1); the long collects the negative-funding carry (funding_feature) across the multi-day hold while the short crowd bleeds and covers. A vol_realized ceiling keeps us out of names in violent freefall (where deep-negative funding is a knife, not a tilt). Distinct from 16 (4h rebalance / faster hold) and 17 (short leg): daily cadence isolates the slower sticky-funding component and adds a freefall filter. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if real fees + slippage on thin daily-rebalanced alt books eat the funding spread. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the daily tilt is disguised beta/size (beaten-down alts bounce) and dies after neutralizing to trailing return. DISCONFIRMER 3: kill if breadth of reliable daily funding history is too low for effective-N.
catalyst: the deepest-negative-funding names each day, out of freefall — a persistent sticky-funding long tilt.
